name: Shephelah
brief: Lowland region between Judean hills and coastal plain
short: The Shephelah was the lowland region between the Judean hills and the coastal plain, known for its fertile valleys and strategic importance (<ref="Josh. 9:1; 10:40; 2Chr. 28:18; Jer. 17:26; 32:44; 33:13">Josh. 9:1; 10:40; 2Chr. 28:18; Jer. 17:26; 32:44; 33:13</ref>).
